name: Cloze CRM
summary: Email-first CRM for freelancers and small teams: contacts, notes and follow-ups built from your inbox, with open tracking, templates and mail merge.
best_for: freelancers, consultants and small sales teams who live in their inbox and want contacts, notes and follow-ups kept in one place
skip_if: you need a ready-made pipeline board for a large sales team, you want a published free plan with known limits, or you need an export we have verified
honest_knock: The pricing page does not name the currency and shows no free plan limits. The importer needed manual column mapping and changed our tag format. The onboarding said it was analysing email history while no mailbox was connected.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Cloze Pro · per monthly, billed annually, Pro is $17 a month billed yearly and $19.99 month to month
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-13 on cloze.com/app/pricing, "$" shown without a currency name) Cloze has four paid plans and a 14 day free trial with no credit card. Cloze Pro for individuals costs $17 a month billed yearly or $19.99 month to month. Business Silver costs $21 per user a month billed yearly or $24.99 month to month, Business Gold $29 or $34.99, and Business Platinum $42 or $49.99. Pro lists smart AI, business-grade email with open tracking, templates and mail merge, and contact management. Silver adds team work, assigned responsibility and privacy controls. Gold adds smart custom fields, advanced integrations, text message syncing, partner tracking and team analytics. Platinum adds a matching engine, smart templates, lead capture, campaign automation, marketing mail, generative AI, lead routing and sub-team hierarchies. A Concierge Service add-on costs $20 per user a month with a $500 monthly minimum. The page says that after the trial you can move to a free plan with contact management and an email inbox, but it shows no price or limits for it. We did not buy a plan, so we do not know the tax added or the free plan limits.
